cover.title: 5 niche things that will make you annoyingly good at selling across europe

inner.title: one return, not 27
inner.body: oss lets you declare vat for every eu customer in one quarterly return once cross-border sales pass €10,000. the q3 return is due 31 october.

inner.title: sell in their language
inner.body: eurobarometer found 90% of eu internet users prefer sites in their own language. 42% had never bought online in another language.

inner.title: pay like the dutch
inner.body: ideal, the dutch bank-to-bank method, had 70% of dutch e-commerce transactions in 2022. a card-only checkout skips how most dutch orders get paid.

inner.title: the 30-day price trap
inner.body: ireland's ccpc says a 'was' price must be your lowest vat-inclusive price in the 30 days before. a quick hike before black friday backfires.

inner.title: the 14-day undo
inner.body: eu consumers can cancel most online purchases within 14 days, no reason given. skip telling them and the european consumer centre says it stretches by a year.

closer.HEADLINE:
europe isn't one market.
it's 27 checkouts.
closer.SUBLINE: same product, different rules at every border.
